test_title: PYST 95: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 30 Mar, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion (s) logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some tree are flower.

II. No flower is red.

**Conclusions:**

I. All tree are red.

II. All red are flower.

III. Some tree are not red.

options.text: Both conclusions II and III follows

solution:
Statements:

I. Some tree are flower.

II. No flower is red.

The least possible Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2eb60c3014182deea3a5f4ecee6f1247b4143c772ff5831a2e185d79e2312611.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All tree are red. - **False **(Because there is no direct relation given between tree and red, so it can be possible but not definite)

II. All red are flower. - **False **(Because No flower is red given, so, All red can never be flower)

III. Some tree are not red. - **True **(Because Some tree are flower and No flower is red, so, Some tree are also not red)

So, Only conclusion III follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Only conclusion III follows"**.
